title: An unfaithful article body never stops the write, and slotless links, tab lists, label-derived contact links and cards of dropped pages are no faults
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The write step writes the planned post's opening in place of an invented article body and goes on; the opening keeps whole sentences or words and passes the excerpt rule; a kept link's labelSlot is the kit's; a slotless address link the plan hides stays; tab and slide lists are not counted; a contact link following its label and a card of a dropped page are skipped, not refused.

tests: the write step writes the planned post's own opening in place of an invented article body, and goes on
a post's opening within a limit keeps whole sentences, else whole words, and is a faithful excerpt
a kept link's labelSlot is the kit's: none or another slot is corrected, the kit's is left as it is
a tab, a photo control or a slotless credit link the plan hides stays as it is; a frame the kit read on no page leaves with nothing; a "Website" line goes with its address
a list of tabs or slides is not counted from the page: one row shows at a time
a contact link whose address the template prints from its own words follows them: never a refused line
a card's link to its own item whose page the plan drops leaves with the card, never a refused line
